title: Smart Fish Detection
description: Real-time ultrasonic distance sensing with intelligent proximity classification. Detects fish presence within 300mm and classifies as Near or Very Near states.

title: Environmental Monitoring
description: Sensirion SHT4x sensor provides precision temperature and humidity readings via I2C with CRC-8 validation, sampled every 3 seconds.

title: Azure Cloud Pipeline
description: Full MQTT pipeline from Si917 MCU through Azure VM to Node-RED dashboard with real-time data streaming, OTA firmware updates, and persistent storage.
